description: Compare 2 to 4 Swiss cantons side by side across every metric of the index (income tax, rent, health premiums, unemployment, sunshine, safety, population and more), each with its value, unit, year and official source, and which canton does better. Use for «Zurich or Zug?» or «compare Geneva, Vaud and Basel». For one canton use get_canton; to rank all 26 use rank_by_metric; for rents alone rent_index.
name: compare_cantons
title: Compare cantons
